rv.q: It is worth seeing for Henry's immense performance, which switches compellingly from humour to fury and from hopefulness to piercing disillusionment.
It’s the must-see performance in town, and the silhouetted image of him wielding a baseball bat and inviting all-comers is one that I shall not easily forget.

cn.t: Critics hail Lenny Henry's outstanding performance as the centerpiece of this dense, unsettling revival of August Wilson's African-American classic, with reviewers calling it truly great work in a production worth seeing.
